pattern.zh: 读写双指针原地压缩
pattern.en: Read/write pointers for in-place compaction

points.zh: 写指针 w 左边是已经确定保留的结果；读指针只往前扫，两个指针都只走一遍。
points.en: Everything left of the write pointer w is final; the read pointer only scans forward, so each pointer moves once.

points.zh: 判断能不能保留时和 nums[w-k] 比，也就是和「结果」比，而不是和上一个读到的原始元素比。
points.en: Decide whether to keep a value by comparing it with nums[w-k], the kept result, not with the previous raw element.

points.zh: 原地合并两个有序数组时从尾部往前写，就不会覆盖还没读到的数据。
points.en: When merging two sorted arrays in place, write from the back so you never overwrite unread data.

pitfalls.zh: 题目要的是新长度，判题只看前 k 个位置；返回数组本身或者去比较 k 之后的内容都会出错。
pitfalls.en: The judge reads only the first k slots; return the new length and never rely on anything past it.

pitfalls.zh: 边遍历边删除（Python 的 list.remove、Java 的 ArrayList.remove）是 O(n²)，还会跳过元素。
pitfalls.en: Deleting while iterating (list.remove, ArrayList.remove) is O(n²) and skips elements.

pitfalls.zh: 排序比较器写成 a - b，值接近 ±2^31 时会溢出；用 Integer.compare 或直接比较大小。
pitfalls.en: A comparator written as a - b overflows near ±2^31; use Integer.compare or a plain < comparison.

pattern.zh: 边扫边查的哈希表
pattern.en: One-pass hash map lookup

points.zh: 先查补数、再存自己：一遍扫描就能找到「之前出现过」的配对，也不会把同一个元素用两次。
points.en: Query the complement before storing the current value: one pass finds earlier partners and never pairs an element with itself.

points.zh: 存什么取决于问什么：要位置就存下标，要个数就存次数，要最早出现的位置就只在第一次出现时存。
points.en: Store what the question needs: an index for positions, a count for how many, and the first index only when you need the earliest.

points.zh: 键可以组合出来：排序后的字符串、计数元组、(行, 值) 对，都能把「同一类」放进同一个桶。
points.en: Keys can be built: a sorted string, a count tuple or a (row, value) pair puts everything of one kind into one bucket.

pitfalls.zh: 先插入再查询，target 恰好等于 2x 时会把同一个元素和自己配成一对。
pitfalls.en: Inserting before querying pairs an element with itself when target equals 2x.

pitfalls.zh: C++ 的 map[key] 读一个不存在的键会插入默认值；只想判断存在时用 find 或 count。
pitfalls.en: In C++, map[key] on a missing key inserts a default value; use find or count to test membership.

pitfalls.zh: Java 里两个 Integer 用 == 比较，超过 127 时可能不相等；用 equals 或先拆箱成 int。
pitfalls.en: In Java, comparing two Integer objects with == can fail above 127; use equals or unbox to int first.

code.python:
def two_sum(nums: list[int], target: int) -> tuple[int, int]:
    seen: dict[int, int] = {}  # value -> index of an earlier element
    for i, x in enumerate(nums):
        if target - x in seen:  # look up before inserting: no self-pairing
            return seen[target - x], i
        seen[x] = i
    return -1, -1

pattern.zh: KMP 前缀函数匹配
pattern.en: KMP prefix function

points.zh: pi[i] 是 pat[0..i] 中「既是真前缀又是真后缀」的最长长度；失配时 j 退回 pi[j-1]，文本指针从不回头。
points.en: pi[i] is the length of the longest proper prefix of pat[0..i] that is also its suffix; on a mismatch j falls back to pi[j-1] and the text pointer never moves back.

points.zh: 建 pi 表和在文本里匹配是同一段循环：建表就是模式串和自己匹配。
points.en: Building pi and scanning the text are the same loop: building the table is the pattern matching against itself.

points.zh: 解析类题目用一个下标手动往前读数字、符号和括号，边界比 split 好处理。
points.en: For parsing tasks, advance one index by hand over digits, signs and brackets; edge cases are easier than with split.

pitfalls.zh: 匹配成功后要令 j = pi[j-1] 继续，否则会漏掉重叠出现（"aaaa" 里的 "aa" 出现 3 次）。
pitfalls.en: After a full match set j = pi[j-1]; otherwise you miss overlapping occurrences ("aa" occurs 3 times in "aaaa").

pitfalls.zh: 在循环里用 + 拼字符串是 O(n²)；Python 先收集到列表再 join，Java 用 StringBuilder。
pitfalls.en: Concatenating strings with + in a loop is O(n²); collect pieces and join in Python, use StringBuilder in Java.

pitfalls.zh: Go 里 s[i] 是字节、len(s) 是字节数；处理中文等多字节字符要先转成 []rune。
pitfalls.en: In Go, s[i] is a byte and len(s) counts bytes; convert to []rune for multi-byte text such as Chinese.

pattern.zh: 可变长度滑动窗口
pattern.en: Variable-size sliding window

points.zh: 右端每步前进一格，左端只在窗口不合法时收缩；两个指针都只前进，总共 O(n)。
points.en: The right end advances every step and the left end moves only while the window is invalid; both only go forward, so the total is O(n).

points.zh: 求最长窗口：收缩完再更新答案；求最短窗口：在「仍然合法」的收缩循环里更新答案。
points.en: For the longest window, update the answer after shrinking; for the shortest, update it inside the shrink loop while the window is still valid.

points.zh: 有序数组上求两数之和、去重、反转用相向双指针；判环、找中点用快慢指针。
points.en: On sorted arrays use opposite-end pointers for pair sums, dedupe and reversal; use fast/slow pointers for cycles and midpoints.

pitfalls.zh: 收缩时忘了把移出窗口的元素计数减一，窗口状态就和实际内容对不上。
pitfalls.en: Forgetting to decrement the count of the element leaving the window desynchronises the window state.

pitfalls.zh: 数组里有负数时，「和超过 k 就收缩」不再单调，滑动窗口失效，要改用前缀和。
pitfalls.en: With negative numbers "shrink when the sum exceeds k" is no longer monotonic and the window breaks; use prefix sums instead.

pitfalls.zh: 「恰好 k 个」很难直接滑，用「至多 k 个」减去「至多 k-1 个」。
pitfalls.en: "Exactly k" is awkward to slide directly; compute at-most(k) minus at-most(k-1).

code.python:
from collections import defaultdict


def longest_unique(s: str) -> int:
    """Length of the longest substring without repeated characters."""
    cnt = defaultdict(int)  # counts inside the window s[left:right+1]
    left = best = 0
    for right, c in enumerate(s):
        cnt[c] += 1
        while cnt[c] > 1:  # shrink until the window is valid again
            cnt[s[left]] -= 1
            left += 1
        best = max(best, right - left + 1)
    return best

pattern.zh: 前缀和 + 哈希计数
pattern.en: Prefix sums with a hash count

points.zh: 区间和等于两个前缀和之差：sum(l..r) = pre[r+1] - pre[l]；前缀数组多开一位，pre[0] = 0。
points.en: A range sum is the difference of two prefix sums: sum(l..r) = pre[r+1] - pre[l]; allocate one extra slot with pre[0] = 0.

points.zh: 统计「和为 k 的子数组」时，哈希表先放 {0: 1}，代表从下标 0 开始的子数组。
points.en: When counting subarrays that sum to k, seed the map with {0: 1} for subarrays that start at index 0.

points.zh: 多次区间加值用差分数组：diff[l] += v，diff[r+1] -= v，最后求一遍前缀和；合并区间先按左端点排序。
points.en: For many range updates use a difference array (diff[l] += v, diff[r+1] -= v, then one prefix pass); to merge intervals, sort by left end first.

pitfalls.zh: 忘了放 {0: 1}，会漏掉所有从下标 0 开始的子数组。
pitfalls.en: Without the {0: 1} seed you miss every subarray that starts at index 0.

pitfalls.zh: 前缀和很容易超过 32 位整数，C++ 用 long long，Java 用 long。
pitfalls.en: Prefix sums overflow 32-bit integers easily; use long long in C++ and long in Java.

pitfalls.zh: 先把当前前缀和存进表再查询，k = 0 时会把空子数组也算进去。
pitfalls.en: Storing the current prefix before querying counts the empty subarray when k = 0.

code.python:
def count_subarrays(nums: list[int], k: int) -> int:
    """Number of non-empty subarrays whose sum is k (negatives allowed)."""
    seen = {0: 1}  # prefix sum -> occurrences; the empty prefix counts once
    pre = ans = 0
    for x in nums:
        pre += x
        ans += seen.get(pre - k, 0)  # sum(j..i) = pre_i - pre_j
        seen[pre] = seen.get(pre, 0) + 1
    return ans

pattern.zh: 左闭右开区间找「第一个为真」
pattern.en: First true on a half-open range

points.zh: 先把问题改写成单调的判定 ok(x)：前面全是假、后面全是真，然后二分找第一个真。
points.en: Rewrite the problem as a monotonic check ok(x), false then true, and search for the first true.

points.zh: 区间 [lo, hi) 左闭右开：ok(mid) 时 hi = mid，否则 lo = mid + 1；循环条件 lo < hi，结束时 lo 就是答案。
points.en: On the half-open range [lo, hi): set hi = mid when ok(mid), else lo = mid + 1; loop while lo < hi, and lo is the answer at the end.

points.zh: 答案范围已知、给定一个答案能 O(n) 验证时，直接对答案二分：最小速度、最大化最小值都是这一类。
points.en: When the answer's range is known and a candidate can be checked in O(n), binary search the answer itself: minimum speed, maximise the minimum and so on.

pitfalls.zh: lo = mid 配合向下取整的 mid 会死循环；用这个模板时只写 lo = mid + 1。
pitfalls.en: lo = mid with a rounded-down mid loops forever; with this template only ever write lo = mid + 1.

pitfalls.zh: (lo + hi) / 2 在 C++、Java、Go 里可能溢出，写成 lo + (hi - lo) / 2。
pitfalls.en: (lo + hi) / 2 can overflow in C++, Java and Go; write lo + (hi - lo) / 2.

pitfalls.zh: hi 本身不会被检查：上界要取到一定可行的值，否则返回的 hi 会被误当成答案。
pitfalls.en: hi itself is never checked: pick an upper bound that is surely feasible, or a returned hi gets mistaken for an answer.

pattern.zh: 单调栈：下一个更大元素
pattern.en: Monotonic stack: next greater element

points.zh: 栈里存下标而不是值：既能取到值，也能算距离（比如「还要等几天才升温」）。
points.en: Keep indexes on the stack, not values: you can still read the value and also measure distances such as days until a warmer day.

points.zh: 每个元素只进栈、出栈各一次，所以虽然套了 while，总复杂度仍是 O(n)。
points.en: Each element is pushed and popped once, so the nested while is still O(n) overall.

points.zh: 求前 k 大用大小为 k 的小根堆；滑动窗口最值用单调双端队列，队头过期就弹出。
points.en: For the top k keep a min-heap of size k; for sliding-window maxima use a monotonic deque and drop the front once it leaves the window.

pitfalls.zh: 有重复值时 < 和 <= 结果不同，先想清楚要「严格更大」还是「大于等于」。
pitfalls.en: With duplicates, < and <= give different answers; decide whether you need strictly greater or greater-or-equal.

pitfalls.zh: Python 的 heapq 只有小根堆，要大根堆就存相反数。
pitfalls.en: Python's heapq is a min-heap only; push negated values to get a max-heap.

pitfalls.zh: Java 的 Stack 类又慢又是同步的，栈和队列都用 ArrayDeque；比较器不要写成 a - b。
pitfalls.en: Java's Stack class is slow and synchronized; use ArrayDeque for stacks and queues, and don't write comparators as a - b.

pattern.zh: 按结束时间排序选区间
pattern.en: Sort by end time, keep what fits

points.zh: 总是选结束最早的区间，给后面留的空间最多。交换论证：任何最优解的第一个区间都能换成它而不变差。
points.en: Always take the interval that ends first; it leaves the most room. Exchange argument: the first pick of any optimal answer can be swapped for it without loss.

points.zh: 最少删除数 = 总数 - 最多保留数；「最少几支箭」也是同一个循环，只是端点相接也算重叠。
points.en: Minimum removals = total minus the maximum kept; "minimum arrows" is the same loop, except that touching endpoints count as overlapping.

points.zh: 写贪心之前先说清楚「为什么局部最优不吃亏」；说不清楚时，多半要换成动态规划。
points.en: Before writing a greedy, state why the local choice never hurts; if you can't, the problem probably needs DP.

pitfalls.zh: 按开始时间排序再贪心，会被一个开始很早、持续很长的区间卡住。
pitfalls.en: Sorting by start time lets one long interval that starts early block everything else.

pitfalls.zh: 端点相接算不算重叠由题意决定：>= 和 > 只差一个字符，答案就不一样。
pitfalls.en: Whether touching endpoints overlap depends on the problem; >= versus > is one character and a different answer.

pitfalls.zh: 比较器写成 a[1] - b[1]，端点接近 ±2^31 时会溢出。
pitfalls.en: A comparator written as a[1] - b[1] overflows near ±2^31.

code.python:
def max_non_overlapping(intervals: list[list[int]]) -> int:
    """Most intervals you can keep with no overlap; [a, b] and [b, c] may touch."""
    count, end = 0, float("-inf")
    for start, finish in sorted(intervals, key=lambda iv: iv[1]):
        if start >= end:  # fits after the last kept interval
            count += 1
            end = finish
    return count

pattern.zh: 反转链表 + 快慢指针
pattern.en: Reverse in place, fast and slow pointers

points.zh: 改指针之前先存下 next。反转只有三步：存 next、指回前驱、整体前移。
points.en: Save next before rewiring. Reversal is three moves: save next, point back, step forward.

points.zh: 头结点可能被删除或替换时，先建一个哑结点 dummy 指向 head，最后返回 dummy.next。
points.en: When the head may be removed or replaced, start from a dummy node that points at head and return dummy.next.

points.zh: 快指针一次两步、慢指针一次一步，用来找中点和判环；找倒数第 k 个结点则让前指针先走 k 步，再和后指针同速前进。
points.en: A fast pointer taking two steps per slow step finds the middle and detects a cycle; for the k-th node from the end, move a lead pointer k steps first, then advance both at the same speed.

pitfalls.zh: 先改了 head.next 再去取 next，后面的链表就丢了。
pitfalls.en: Rewiring head.next before saving it loses the rest of the list.

pitfalls.zh: 访问 fast.next.next 之前要确认 fast 和 fast.next 都不为空。
pitfalls.en: Check that fast and fast.next are non-null before touching fast.next.next.

pitfalls.zh: 把链表拆成两段后忘了把前半段的尾部置空，合并或遍历时会成环。
pitfalls.en: After splitting a list, forgetting to null out the first half's tail creates a cycle when you merge or traverse.

pattern.zh: 按层 BFS
pattern.en: Level-order BFS

points.zh: 每一轮先记下队列长度，正好处理这么多个结点，层与层就分开了。
points.en: Record the queue length at the start of each round; processing exactly that many nodes separates one level from the next.

points.zh: 写递归 DFS 前先想清楚「子树返回什么」：深度、是否平衡、结点数，都是把左右两边的结果合并。
points.en: Before writing a recursive DFS, decide what a subtree returns (depth, balance, size); the answer is always a merge of left and right.

points.zh: 前序、中序、后序的区别只在于「处理当前结点」放在两次递归的前面、中间还是后面。
points.en: Pre-, in- and post-order differ only in whether you handle the current node before, between or after the two recursive calls.

pitfalls.zh: 用一直在变化的队列长度当循环上界，会把下一层的结点也算进这一层。
pitfalls.en: Using the live queue length as the loop bound mixes the next level into the current one.

pitfalls.zh: Python 用 list.pop(0) 当队列是 O(n) 的，要用 collections.deque。
pitfalls.en: list.pop(0) is O(n) in Python; use collections.deque for queues.

pitfalls.zh: 树退化成链时递归深度能到 10^5，Python 会爆栈；改成迭代或调高 recursionlimit。
pitfalls.en: A degenerate tree recurses 10^5 levels deep and overflows Python's stack; go iterative or raise the recursion limit.

pattern.zh: 后序返回单边贡献，全局记录拐弯路径
pattern.en: Return the one-sided gain, record the bent path globally

points.zh: 递归函数返回「从当前结点往下走的最好单边路径」，因为要继续往上接的路径只能选一边。
points.en: The recursion returns the best one-sided downward path, because a path that continues upward can use only one child.

points.zh: 在当前结点拐弯的路径（左 + 根 + 右）只用来更新全局答案，不返回给父结点。
points.en: The path that bends at the node (left + node + right) only updates the global answer; it is never returned to the parent.

points.zh: 根到叶的路径题用「进入时加、离开时减」维护当前路径；任意起点的路径和用前缀和 + 哈希表。
points.en: For root-to-leaf paths, add on entry and remove on exit; for path sums starting anywhere, use prefix sums with a hash map.

pitfalls.zh: 全局答案初始化成 0，所有值都是负数的树会得到错误的 0。
pitfalls.en: Initialising the answer to 0 is wrong when every value in the tree is negative.

pitfalls.zh: 子树贡献为负时要截成 0（这一边不接），否则会把答案拖低。
pitfalls.en: Clamp a negative child gain to 0 (don't take that side), or it drags the answer down.

pitfalls.zh: 把拐弯路径也返回给父结点，等于让一条路径分叉，结果会偏大。
pitfalls.en: Returning the bent path to the parent lets a path fork, which overcounts.

code.python:
class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
        self.val, self.left, self.right = val, left, right


def max_path_sum(root) -> int:
    """Largest sum of any non-empty path between two nodes."""
    best = float("-inf")

    def gain(node) -> int:  # best downward path sum that starts at node
        nonlocal best
        if not node:
            return 0
        left, right = max(gain(node.left), 0), max(gain(node.right), 0)
        best = max(best, node.val + left + right)  # the path that bends at node
        return node.val + max(left, right)  # only one side can continue upward

    gain(root)
    return best

pattern.zh: 前序定根，中序分左右
pattern.en: Preorder picks the root, inorder splits the sides

points.zh: 前序的第一个值是根；在中序里找到它，左边是左子树，右边是右子树。
points.en: The first preorder value is the root; find it in inorder, and everything to its left is the left subtree, everything to its right the right subtree.

points.zh: 用哈希表存「值 → 中序下标」，每次切分 O(1)，整体 O(n)。
points.en: A value-to-inorder-index map makes each split O(1) and the whole build O(n).

points.zh: 按「先左后右」递归时，前序指针顺序往后取就是下一个根，不用计算子数组长度；后序 + 中序则从后往前取、先右后左。
points.en: Recursing left before right, the next preorder value is always the next root, so no lengths are needed; with postorder plus inorder, read from the back and build right before left.

pitfalls.zh: 值有重复时中序位置不唯一，这个方法就不成立了。
pitfalls.en: With duplicate values the inorder position is ambiguous and this method breaks.

pitfalls.zh: 每层递归都切片复制数组（Python 切片、Java copyOfRange），会退化成 O(n²)。
pitfalls.en: Copying subarrays at every level (Python slices, Java copyOfRange) degrades the build to O(n²).

pitfalls.zh: 后序 + 中序时如果仍然先建左子树，取到的根的顺序就错了。
pitfalls.en: With postorder plus inorder, building the left subtree first takes the roots in the wrong order.

pattern.zh: 迭代中序：按顺序走 BST
pattern.en: Iterative inorder walks a BST in sorted order

points.zh: BST 的中序遍历是升序的：第 k 小、验证 BST、找前驱后继，都能转成中序问题。
points.en: An inorder walk of a BST is sorted, so k-th smallest, validation and predecessor/successor all become inorder problems.

points.zh: 验证 BST 要把上下界 (lo, hi) 往下传，每个结点都必须落在祖先给出的开区间里。
points.en: To validate a BST, pass (lo, hi) bounds down; every node must sit strictly inside the range its ancestors allow.

points.zh: 查找和插入只走一条路径，复杂度是 O(h)：平衡时 O(log n)，退化成链时 O(n)。
points.en: Search and insert follow a single path, O(h): O(log n) when balanced and O(n) on a chain.

pitfalls.zh: 只拿结点和它的左右孩子比较，发现不了「右子树深处有比根还小的值」。
pitfalls.en: Comparing a node only with its children misses a small value deep in the right subtree.

pitfalls.zh: 用 INT_MIN / INT_MAX 当边界，结点值恰好是极值时会误判；用 long 或空值表示「无界」。
pitfalls.en: Using INT_MIN/INT_MAX as bounds fails when a node holds that exact value; use long or null for "unbounded".

pitfalls.zh: 迭代中序里忘了转向 node.right，会重复弹出同一批结点或者提前结束。
pitfalls.en: Forgetting to move to node.right in the iterative walk repeats nodes or stops early.

pattern.zh: 多源 BFS，一步扩一圈
pattern.en: Multi-source BFS, one ring per step

points.zh: 所有起点一开始就一起入队，相当于从一个虚拟的超级源点出发；BFS 的层数就是最短距离。
points.en: Enqueue every source at the start, as if from one virtual super source; the BFS layer is the shortest distance.

points.zh: 入队时就标记已访问，同一个格子不会被重复加入。
points.en: Mark a cell visited when it is enqueued, so it is never added twice.

points.zh: 只问连通块（岛屿个数、面积）时 DFS、BFS 都可以；问最少步数必须用 BFS。
points.en: For connected components (island count, area) DFS or BFS both work; for the fewest steps you need BFS.

pitfalls.zh: 出队时才标记，同一个格子会被多个邻居重复入队，大网格上会超时。
pitfalls.en: Marking on dequeue lets several neighbours enqueue the same cell, which times out on large grids.

pitfalls.zh: 一开始就没有新鲜橘子时答案是 0，既不是 -1，也不是层数。
pitfalls.en: When nothing is fresh at the start the answer is 0, not -1 and not the layer count.

pitfalls.zh: 递归 DFS 在 1000×1000 的网格上会爆栈；大网格用 BFS 或显式栈。
pitfalls.en: Recursive DFS on a 1000×1000 grid overflows the stack; use BFS or an explicit stack.

code.python:
from collections import deque


def minutes_to_rot(grid: list[list[int]]) -> int:
    """0 empty, 1 fresh, 2 rotten. Minutes until nothing is fresh, or -1."""
    rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    q = deque((r, c) for r in range(rows) for c in range(cols) if grid[r][c] == 2)
    fresh = sum(row.count(1) for row in grid)
    minutes = 0
    while q and fresh:
        minutes += 1
        for _ in range(len(q)):  # every rotten cell spreads one step this minute
            r, c = q.popleft()
            for nr, nc in ((r + 1, c), (r - 1, c), (r, c + 1), (r, c - 1)):
                if 0 <= nr < rows and 0 <= nc < cols and grid[nr][nc] == 1:
                    grid[nr][nc] = 2  # mark when enqueued, not when popped
                    fresh -= 1
                    q.append((nr, nc))
    return -1 if fresh else minutes

pattern.zh: 并查集：路径压缩 + 按大小合并
pattern.en: Union-find with path compression and union by size

points.zh: find 时做路径压缩，union 时把小树挂到大树下；两者一起用，单次操作几乎是常数时间。
points.en: Compress paths in find and hang the smaller tree under the larger in union; together each operation is close to constant time.

points.zh: union 返回 false 说明两点本来就连通：无向图判环、找冗余连接都靠它。
points.en: union returning false means the two ends were already connected, which is how you detect cycles and redundant edges.

points.zh: 连通块个数、块的大小这类信息只记在根上，合并时累加。
points.en: Keep per-component data such as size only on the root and add it up when merging.

pitfalls.zh: 用 parent[a] == parent[b] 判断连通是错的，必须比较 find(a) == find(b)。
pitfalls.en: parent[a] == parent[b] does not mean connected; compare find(a) == find(b).

pitfalls.zh: 合并时写成 parent[a] = b，而不是把两个根连起来，会破坏树的结构。
pitfalls.en: Writing parent[a] = b instead of linking the two roots corrupts the structure.

pitfalls.zh: 结点是字符串或坐标时，先映射成 0..n-1 的编号，或者用哈希表存 parent。
pitfalls.en: When nodes are strings or coordinates, map them to 0..n-1 first, or keep parent in a hash map.

pattern.zh: Kahn 算法：入度为 0 的先出队
pattern.en: Kahn's algorithm: dequeue zero in-degree nodes

points.zh: 入度为 0 的点没有未完成的前置依赖，可以先放；放下之后把它指向的点入度减一。
points.en: A node with in-degree 0 has no unfinished prerequisites; place it, then decrement the in-degree of everything it points to.

points.zh: 输出的点数少于 n，说明剩下的点都在环上：「能不能修完所有课」就是这样判断的。
points.en: If fewer than n nodes come out, the rest sit on a cycle; that is the whole check for course-schedule problems.

points.zh: 要求字典序最小的拓扑序时，把队列换成小根堆。
points.en: For the lexicographically smallest order, replace the queue with a min-heap.

pitfalls.zh: 边的方向读反（「a 依赖 b」应该建 b → a），整个顺序就倒过来了。
pitfalls.en: Reading an edge backwards ("a depends on b" means b → a) reverses the whole order.

pitfalls.zh: 只把一开始入度为 0 的点入队，后面减到 0 的点忘了入队。
pitfalls.en: Enqueuing only the nodes that start at in-degree 0 and forgetting the ones that drop to 0 later.

pitfalls.zh: DFS 写拓扑排序时只有「访问过 / 没访问」两种状态是判不出环的，还需要「访问中」这第三种状态。
pitfalls.en: A DFS topological sort with only visited/unvisited cannot see cycles; it needs a third "in progress" state.

code.python:
from collections import deque


def topo_order(n: int, edges: list[tuple[int, int]]) -> list[int]:
    """Edge (u, v) means u comes before v. Returns [] if there is a cycle."""
    graph = [[] for _ in range(n)]
    indeg = [0] * n
    for u, v in edges:
        graph[u].append(v)
        indeg[v] += 1
    q = deque(i for i in range(n) if indeg[i] == 0)
    order = []
    while q:
        u = q.popleft()
        order.append(u)
        for v in graph[u]:
            indeg[v] -= 1
            if indeg[v] == 0:  # every prerequisite of v is placed
                q.append(v)
    return order if len(order) == n else []

pattern.zh: Dijkstra：堆 + 懒删除
pattern.en: Dijkstra with a heap and lazy deletion

points.zh: 每次从堆里取出当前距离最小的点，它的距离就确定了；前提是所有边权非负。
points.en: The node popped with the smallest tentative distance is final; this only holds when every edge weight is non-negative.

points.zh: 不做 decrease-key：直接把新距离压进堆，弹出时发现比 dist 大就跳过（懒删除）。
points.en: Skip decrease-key: push the new distance and, on pop, discard entries larger than dist (lazy deletion).

points.zh: 边权只有 0 和 1 时用双端队列 BFS；有负权用 Bellman-Ford；状态里带「已用次数」时，把 (点, 次数) 当成一个新结点。
points.en: With 0/1 weights use deque BFS; with negative weights use Bellman-Ford; when the state carries extra data such as stops used, treat (node, count) as the node.

pitfalls.zh: 不跳过过期的堆元素，同一个点会被反复松弛，稠密图上会超时。
pitfalls.en: Not skipping stale heap entries relaxes the same node again and again and times out on dense graphs.

pitfalls.zh: 距离累加超出 32 位整数；用 INT_MAX 当无穷大时，d + w 还会溢出成负数。
pitfalls.en: Distances outgrow 32-bit integers, and INT_MAX used as infinity turns negative once w is added.

pitfalls.zh: 有向图当成无向图建边（或者反过来），所有距离都会错。
pitfalls.en: Building a directed graph as undirected (or the reverse) makes every distance wrong.

pattern.zh: Kruskal：按边权排序 + 并查集
pattern.en: Kruskal: sort the edges, join with union-find

points.zh: 按边权从小到大看每条边：能连起两个不同连通块就选，否则跳过（选了会成环）。
points.en: Go through the edges from lightest to heaviest; take an edge if it joins two different components, otherwise skip it (it would close a cycle).

points.zh: 选够 n-1 条边就是一棵生成树；最后不够 n-1 条，说明图不连通。
points.en: n-1 chosen edges form a spanning tree; fewer than that means the graph is disconnected.

points.zh: 点少边多的稠密图（比如坐标点两两相连）用 O(n²) 的 Prim，往往比给所有边排序更快。
points.en: On dense graphs such as all pairs of points, the O(n²) form of Prim is often faster than sorting every edge.

pitfalls.zh: 没检查是否连通，直接返回累加的边权。
pitfalls.en: Returning the summed weight without checking that every node got connected.

pitfalls.zh: 坐标点两两连边有 n²/2 条，内存和排序时间都可能超限。
pitfalls.en: All pairs of points give n²/2 edges, which can exceed both the memory and the time limit for sorting.

pitfalls.zh: 点的编号从 1 开始，并查集却只开了 n 个位置。
pitfalls.en: Nodes numbered from 1 overflow a union-find sized n by one.

code.python:
def mst_weight(n: int, edges: list[tuple[int, int, int]]) -> int:
    """Undirected edges (u, v, w). Weight of a minimum spanning tree, or -1 if disconnected."""
    parent = list(range(n))

    def find(x: int) -> int:
        while parent[x] != x:
            parent[x] = parent[parent[x]]
            x = parent[x]
        return x

    total = used = 0
    for u, v, w in sorted(edges, key=lambda e: e[2]):
        ru, rv = find(u), find(v)
        if ru != rv:  # the lightest edge joining two different components
            parent[ru] = rv
            total += w
            used += 1
    return total if used == n - 1 else -1

pattern.zh: 选择、递归、撤销；同层跳过重复
pattern.en: Choose, recurse, undo; skip duplicates on the same level

points.zh: 模板只有三步：做选择、递归、撤销选择；path 是整个搜索共用的一份。
points.en: The template is three moves: choose, recurse, undo. path is a single buffer shared by the whole search.

points.zh: 先排序，再用 i > start && nums[i] == nums[i-1] 跳过：同一层不重复选相同的值，更深的层可以。
points.en: Sort first, then skip with i > start && nums[i] == nums[i-1]: a value is not reused on the same level, but deeper levels may use it.

points.zh: 组合从 start 往后选，避免 {1,2} 和 {2,1} 同时出现；排列每次从头选，用 used 数组标记。
points.en: Combinations pick from start onward so {1,2} and {2,1} don't both appear; permutations scan from the beginning with a used array.

pitfalls.zh: 结果里直接存 path 的引用，回溯结束后所有结果都变成同一个空列表。
pitfalls.en: Storing a reference to path leaves every result as the same empty list once the search finishes.

pitfalls.zh: 把 i > start 写成 i > 0，更深层里合法的重复值也会被跳过。
pitfalls.en: Writing i > 0 instead of i > start also skips legitimate repeats on deeper levels.

pitfalls.zh: 忘了先排序，相同的值不相邻，去重判断就失效了。
pitfalls.en: Forgetting to sort leaves equal values apart, and the duplicate check does nothing.

pattern.zh: 按切分点回溯 + 回文预处理
pattern.en: Backtrack over cut points with a palindrome table

points.zh: 回溯的每一层决定「下一段切到哪里」，start 走到 n 就得到一种完整的切法。
points.en: Each level decides where the next piece ends; when start reaches n you have one complete split.

points.zh: 先用 O(n²) 的区间 DP 算出每个子串是不是回文，回溯里的判断就是 O(1)。
points.en: Precompute an O(n²) table of which substrings are palindromes so each check inside the search is O(1).

points.zh: 复原 IP 地址、单词拆分也是同一个框架，只是「这一段是否合法」的判断不同。
points.en: Restoring IP addresses and word break use the same frame; only the "is this piece valid" test changes.

pitfalls.zh: 在回溯里每次都重新用双指针判断回文，重复计算会让常数大很多。
pitfalls.en: Re-checking palindromes with two pointers inside the search repeats work and inflates the constant.

pitfalls.zh: 只要求方案数或最少切几刀时，不要枚举，改用 DP。
pitfalls.en: If you only need the number of ways or the fewest cuts, don't enumerate; use DP.

pitfalls.zh: 子串下标是左闭右开还是左闭右闭要统一；s[start:end+1] 和 substring(start, end+1) 很容易差一位。
pitfalls.en: Keep one convention for substring bounds; s[start:end+1] and substring(start, end+1) are easy to get off by one.

pattern.zh: N 皇后：按列和两条对角线剪枝
pattern.en: N-Queens: prune by column and both diagonals

points.zh: 每行只放一个皇后，搜索树只在列上分叉；列、主对角线 r-c、副对角线 r+c 各用一个数组标记。
points.en: Place one queen per row so the search branches only on columns; mark columns, diagonals (r-c) and anti-diagonals (r+c) in three arrays.

points.zh: 剪枝越早越好：递归之前就判断冲突，而不是放满整个棋盘再检查。
points.en: Prune as early as possible: test for conflicts before recursing, not after the board is full.

points.zh: 数独、组合总和这类题先排序，在「剩下的值已经不可能满足」时用 break，比 continue 省得多。
points.en: For sudoku and combination-sum style problems, sort first and break as soon as the remaining values cannot work; break saves far more than continue.

pitfalls.zh: 主对角线下标 r-c 会是负数，要加上 n-1 的偏移。
pitfalls.en: The diagonal index r-c can be negative; offset it by n-1.

pitfalls.zh: 回溯返回前忘了把标记改回去，后面的分支全被误剪。
pitfalls.en: Forgetting to clear the marks before returning wrongly prunes every later branch.

pitfalls.zh: 需要输出棋盘时，用可变的字符数组逐格修改，最后再转字符串，不要每一步都复制整盘。
pitfalls.en: When printing boards, edit a mutable character buffer and convert it once at the end instead of copying the whole board at every step.

pattern.zh: 一维 DP + 滚动变量
pattern.en: 1-D DP with rolling variables

points.zh: 先用一句话定义状态，比如 dp[i] = 只看前 i 个元素时的最优值；状态说清楚了，转移通常就出来了。
points.en: Define the state in one sentence, such as dp[i] = the best answer using the first i elements; once that is precise, the transition usually follows.

points.zh: 转移只看「最后一步做了什么」：第 i 个选还是不选，最后一跳是 1 步还是 2 步。
points.en: Derive the transition from the last decision: take element i or not, last jump of 1 step or 2.

points.zh: dp[i] 只依赖前一两项时，用两个变量滚动，空间从 O(n) 降到 O(1)。
points.en: When dp[i] depends only on the previous one or two values, roll two variables and cut space from O(n) to O(1).

pitfalls.zh: dp 和输入的下标错位：dp 多开一位时 dp[0] 表示「什么都没选」，答案在 dp[n]。
pitfalls.en: dp and input indexes drift apart: with one extra slot dp[0] means "nothing chosen yet" and the answer is dp[n].

pitfalls.zh: 滚动更新时先覆盖了 prev1 再拿它算新值，用到的已经是新数据了。
pitfalls.en: When rolling, overwriting prev1 before computing the new value means you read the updated value by mistake.

pitfalls.zh: 方案数很快会超出 64 位；题目要求取模时，每一步都要取模。
pitfalls.en: Counts quickly outgrow 64 bits; when the problem asks for a modulus, apply it at every step.

pattern.zh: 网格 DP 压成一行
pattern.en: Grid DP compressed to one row

points.zh: dp[r][c] 只依赖上方和左方，按行从左到右填，一行数组就够：更新前 dp[c] 是上方，dp[c-1] 是左方。
points.en: dp[r][c] depends only on the cells above and to the left, so fill row by row, left to right, in one array: before the update dp[c] is "above" and dp[c-1] is "left".

points.zh: 第一行、第一列只有一个来源，要么单独处理，要么用无穷大哨兵统一写法。
points.en: The first row and column have a single source; handle them separately or use an infinity sentinel.

points.zh: 路径计数就把 min 换成加法；有障碍的格子直接置 0。
points.en: To count paths, replace min with addition and set obstacle cells to 0.

pitfalls.zh: 哨兵用 INT_MAX 再加上格子值会溢出，要保证只在有限值上做加法。
pitfalls.en: Adding a cell value to an INT_MAX sentinel overflows; only ever add to finite values.

pitfalls.zh: 允许往四个方向走时没有填表顺序，DP 不成立，要用 BFS 或 Dijkstra。
pitfalls.en: If moves can go in all four directions there is no fill order and DP fails; use BFS or Dijkstra.

pitfalls.zh: 压成一行之后，如果转移还需要左上角的值，要在它被覆盖前先存到变量里。
pitfalls.en: After compressing to one row, save the top-left value in a variable before it is overwritten if the transition needs it.

pattern.zh: 0/1 背包倒序，完全背包正序
pattern.en: 0/1 knapsack backwards, unbounded forwards

points.zh: 0/1 背包倒序遍历容量，保证 dp[s-x] 还是「没用过 x」的旧值；完全背包正序遍历，允许同一件物品重复使用。
points.en: The 0/1 knapsack loops capacity downwards so dp[s-x] is still the value without x; the unbounded version loops upwards so an item can be reused.

points.zh: 物品在外层、容量在内层，数的是组合（不计顺序）；容量在外层、物品在内层，数的是排列。
points.en: Items outside and capacity inside counts combinations (order ignored); capacity outside and items inside counts permutations.

points.zh: 很多题要先转化成背包：「分成两个和相等的子集」= 能否凑出 sum/2；「目标和」= 凑出 (sum+target)/2。
points.en: Many problems reduce to a knapsack: equal-sum partition asks whether sum/2 is reachable, and target sum asks for (sum+target)/2.

pitfalls.zh: 0/1 背包写成正序，同一件物品会被用很多次。
pitfalls.en: Looping a 0/1 knapsack forwards uses the same item many times.

pitfalls.zh: 计数问题 dp[0] = 1（什么都不选也是一种方案）；求最值问题 dp[0] = 0，其余初始化为无穷。
pitfalls.en: For counting, dp[0] = 1 (choosing nothing is one way); for min/max, dp[0] = 0 and everything else starts at infinity.

pitfalls.zh: 转化成 (sum+target)/2 之前没检查奇偶性和正负，会得到错误的下标。
pitfalls.en: Reducing to (sum+target)/2 without checking parity and sign gives a bad index.

code.python:
def count_subsets(nums: list[int], target: int) -> int:
    """Ways to pick a subset (each item at most once) that sums to target."""
    dp = [1] + [0] * target  # dp[s]: ways to reach sum s
    for x in nums:
        for s in range(target, x - 1, -1):  # backwards: x is used at most once
            dp[s] += dp[s - x]
    return dp[target]


def count_combinations(coins: list[int], amount: int) -> int:
    """Ways to make amount with unlimited coins, order ignored."""
    dp = [1] + [0] * amount
    for coin in coins:  # coins outside: each multiset is counted once
        for s in range(coin, amount + 1):  # forwards: a coin may be reused
            dp[s] += dp[s - coin]
    return dp[amount]

pattern.zh: LIS：tails 数组 + 二分
pattern.en: LIS with a tails array and binary search

points.zh: tails[k] 是长度为 k+1 的递增子序列可能的最小结尾；它本身是递增的，所以可以二分。
points.en: tails[k] is the smallest possible tail of an increasing subsequence of length k+1; it is itself sorted, so you can binary search it.

points.zh: 严格递增用 lower_bound（第一个 ≥ x），非递减用 upper_bound（第一个 > x）。
points.en: Strictly increasing uses lower_bound (first ≥ x); non-decreasing uses upper_bound (first > x).

points.zh: 二维的「信封嵌套」先按宽升序、宽相同时按高降序排序，再对高做 LIS。
points.en: For 2-D nesting such as envelopes, sort by width ascending and by height descending on ties, then run LIS on the heights.

pitfalls.zh: tails 数组不是真实存在的最长子序列，只有长度是对的；要输出方案得另外记录前驱。
pitfalls.en: tails is not an actual longest subsequence, only its length is right; record predecessors if you must output one.

pitfalls.zh: 严格和非严格用错了二分函数，重复元素多的用例会差 1 甚至更多。
pitfalls.en: Using the wrong bound for strict versus non-strict is off by one or more on inputs with many duplicates.

pitfalls.zh: 要求「最长子序列有几个」时，O(n log n) 写法不够，要回到 O(n²) 的 dp 加计数数组。
pitfalls.en: Counting how many longest subsequences there are needs the O(n²) dp with a count array.

pattern.zh: 双串 DP：dp[i][j] 看两个前缀
pattern.en: Two-string DP over prefixes

points.zh: dp[i][j] 定义在前缀上：a 的前 i 个字符和 b 的前 j 个字符；多开一行一列表示空串。
points.en: dp[i][j] is defined on prefixes, the first i characters of a and the first j of b, with an extra row and column for the empty string.

points.zh: 末尾字符相等就继承 dp[i-1][j-1]；不相等时，替换、删除、插入分别对应左上、上、左三个格子。
points.en: If the last characters match, inherit dp[i-1][j-1]; otherwise replace, delete and insert map to the diagonal, upper and left cells.

points.zh: 最长公共子序列、不同的子序列、通配符匹配都是这张表，只是转移不同。
points.en: Longest common subsequence, distinct subsequences and wildcard matching all use this table with different transitions.

pitfalls.zh: dp 的下标是前缀长度，对应的字符是 a[i-1]；写成 a[i] 会错一位。
pitfalls.en: dp indexes are prefix lengths, so the matching character is a[i-1]; writing a[i] is off by one.

pitfalls.zh: 忘了初始化第 0 行和第 0 列（变成空串需要删 i 次，从空串变来需要插 j 次）。
pitfalls.en: Forgetting row 0 and column 0: reaching the empty string takes i deletions, building from it takes j insertions.

pitfalls.zh: 压成一行时，左上角的值会被本行覆盖，需要额外一个变量保存。
pitfalls.en: In a one-row version the diagonal value is overwritten by the current row; keep it in a separate variable.

pattern.zh: 区间 DP：左端点倒序枚举
pattern.en: Interval DP with the left end running backwards

points.zh: dp[i][j] 只依赖更短的区间 dp[i+1][*] 和 dp[*][j-1]，所以 i 倒序、j 正序填表。
points.en: dp[i][j] depends only on shorter ranges, dp[i+1][*] and dp[*][j-1], so fill i backwards and j forwards.

points.zh: 两端字符相等就向内收缩并加 2，否则去掉一端，取两种情况的较大值。
points.en: If the two ends match, shrink inward and add 2; otherwise drop one end and keep the better of the two.

points.zh: 只问回文子串（必须连续）时，中心扩展法 O(n²) 时间、O(1) 空间，更简单。
points.en: For palindromic substrings (contiguous), expanding around each center is simpler: O(n²) time and O(1) space.

pitfalls.zh: i 正序枚举时 dp[i+1][*] 还没有算出来，结果全错。
pitfalls.en: Iterating i forwards reads dp[i+1][*] before it has been computed.

pitfalls.zh: 子序列（可以不连续）和子串（必须连续）是两道题，转移不能混用。
pitfalls.en: Subsequence (gaps allowed) and substring (contiguous) are different problems with different transitions.

pitfalls.zh: 中心扩展要同时试奇数中心 (i, i) 和偶数中心 (i, i+1)。
pitfalls.en: Center expansion must try both odd centers (i, i) and even centers (i, i+1).

pattern.zh: 以 i 结尾的状态：同时记最大和最小
pattern.en: Ending-at-i states: track both max and min

points.zh: 状态定义成「以 i 结尾」，连续子数组的转移就只有两种：接在前一段后面，或者从 i 重新开始。
points.en: Define the state as "ending at i"; a contiguous subarray then has two transitions: extend the previous run or restart at i.

points.zh: 乘法遇到负数时最大会变成最小，所以要同时维护最大和最小两个状态。
points.en: A negative factor turns the maximum into the minimum, so keep both a max state and a min state.

points.zh: 状态机 DP 就是给每个位置多设几个状态（持有 / 不持有、上一个选没选），把状态之间的每条转移都写出来。
points.en: State-machine DP gives each position a few states (holding or not, previous taken or not) and writes out every transition between them.

pitfalls.zh: 先更新了 hi 再用新的 hi 去算 lo，用到的是同一轮已经改过的值。
pitfalls.en: Updating hi first and then computing lo from the new hi mixes values from the same step.

pitfalls.zh: 答案初始化成 0，全是负数的数组就会出错。
pitfalls.en: Starting the answer at 0 is wrong for an all-negative array.

pitfalls.zh: 最大子数组和（Kadane）的转移是 cur = max(x, cur + x)，不要漏掉「重新开始」这一项。
pitfalls.en: Kadane's maximum subarray sum uses cur = max(x, cur + x); don't drop the restart option.

code.python:
def max_product(nums: list[int]) -> int:
    """Largest product of a non-empty contiguous subarray."""
    hi = lo = best = nums[0]  # max and min product of a subarray ending here
    for x in nums[1:]:
        cand = (x, hi * x, lo * x)  # restart, or extend; a negative x swaps max and min
        hi, lo = max(cand), min(cand)
        best = max(best, hi)
    return best

pattern.zh: 持有 / 冷却 / 空仓三状态
pattern.en: Three states: holding, cooling down, free

points.zh: 先写清楚每天结束时可能处于哪几种状态，再写「昨天的哪种状态 + 今天的什么动作」能到达它。
points.en: Name the states you can be in at the end of a day, then list which state yesterday plus which action today reaches each one.

points.zh: 同一天的几个新值都要用前一天的旧值计算，所以要同时赋值或者先存临时变量。
points.en: All of today's values must come from yesterday's, so assign them simultaneously or through temporaries.

points.zh: 最多 k 次交易就加一维 k；手续费在每次卖出（或买入）时扣一次；只交易一次就是「记录历史最低价」。
points.en: At most k trades adds a k dimension; a fee is charged once per sale (or purchase); a single trade is just tracking the lowest price so far.

pitfalls.zh: 持有状态初始化成 0，相当于第 0 天白送了一股。
pitfalls.en: Starting the holding state at 0 means you got a share for free on day 0.

pitfalls.zh: 用负无穷做初值时，C++ / Java 里 hold + p 会溢出；取 MIN / 2 这样的值。
pitfalls.en: With negative infinity as the start value, hold + p overflows in C++ and Java; use something like MIN / 2.

pitfalls.zh: 有冷却期时，买入只能从「空仓」状态转过来，不能从「刚卖出」状态直接买。
pitfalls.en: With a cooldown you can buy only from the free state, never straight after selling.

pattern.zh: 按结束时间排序 + 二分找上一个兼容任务
pattern.en: Sort by end, binary search the last compatible job

points.zh: 按结束时间排序后，dp[i] = 前 i 个任务的最优值；第 i 个任务要么不选，要么接在最后一个不冲突的任务后面。
points.en: After sorting by end time, dp[i] is the best over the first i jobs; job i is either skipped or appended after the last job that doesn't overlap it.

points.zh: 「最后一个不冲突的任务」在结束时间数组里二分查找，整体 O(n log n)。
points.en: Find the last compatible job by binary searching the end times, for O(n log n) overall.

points.zh: 「把数组分成 k 段」这类题，状态通常是 dp[段数][结尾位置]，转移时枚举最后一段从哪里开始。
points.en: "Split the array into k parts" problems usually use dp[parts][end] and enumerate where the last part starts.

pitfalls.zh: 首尾相接算不算冲突，决定了用 upper_bound 还是 lower_bound。
pitfalls.en: Whether touching endpoints conflict decides between upper_bound and lower_bound.

pitfalls.zh: 按开始时间排序、每次贪心选利润最高的，在带权的版本里不成立。
pitfalls.en: Sorting by start time and greedily taking the highest profit fails once jobs carry weights.

pitfalls.zh: 排序时只排了结束时间，开始时间和利润没有跟着一起动。
pitfalls.en: Sorting only the end times without moving the start times and profits along with them.

code.python:
from bisect import bisect_right


def max_profit(start: list[int], end: list[int], profit: list[int]) -> int:
    """Best total profit of non-overlapping jobs; a job may start when another ends."""
    jobs = sorted(zip(end, start, profit))
    ends = [e for e, _, _ in jobs]
    dp = [0] * (len(jobs) + 1)  # dp[i]: best using the first i jobs by end time
    for i, (_, s, p) in enumerate(jobs):
        k = bisect_right(ends, s, 0, i)  # jobs[:k] all end by time s
        dp[i + 1] = max(dp[i], dp[k] + p)  # skip job i, or take it after jobs[:k]
    return dp[-1]

pattern.zh: 树形 DP：每个结点返回（选，不选）
pattern.en: Tree DP: each node returns (take, skip)

points.zh: 树形 DP 用后序遍历：先拿到左右子树的结果，再算当前结点，每个结点返回一个小元组。
points.en: Tree DP runs post-order: get both children's results first, then compute the current node, returning a small tuple.

points.zh: 按「当前结点选不选」拆状态，比在父结点里往下看两层更简单，也不会重复计算。
points.en: Splitting the state by whether the current node is taken is simpler than looking two levels down from the parent, and nothing is computed twice.

points.zh: 两人博弈题常用「当前先手比对手多拿多少」作为状态：dp[i][j] = max(nums[i] - dp[i+1][j], nums[j] - dp[i][j-1])。
points.en: Two-player games often use the score difference for the player to move: dp[i][j] = max(nums[i] - dp[i+1][j], nums[j] - dp[i][j-1]).

pitfalls.zh: 不返回元组，而是用「祖父 + 孙子」的写法又不做记忆化，会指数级重复计算。
pitfalls.en: The grandparent-plus-grandchildren version without memoization repeats work exponentially.

pitfalls.zh: 不选当前结点时，孩子也不一定要选，每个孩子都要取 max(选, 不选)。
pitfalls.en: When the node is skipped the children are free, so take max(take, skip) for each child, not just take.

pitfalls.zh: 博弈题如果按「我的得分」建状态，往往还得再记对手的得分；用差值更省事。
pitfalls.en: Modelling a game by "my score" usually forces you to track the opponent as well; the difference is simpler.

pattern.zh: 惰性迭代器：hasNext 负责前进
pattern.en: Lazy iterator: hasNext does the advancing

points.zh: 把「跳过空行、走到下一个有效元素」放进 hasNext，next 只负责取值；这样连续调用多次 hasNext 也没有副作用。
points.en: Put "skip empty rows and reach the next valid element" in hasNext and let next only read; calling hasNext repeatedly then has no side effects.

points.zh: 只保存位置（行号、列号），不要在构造函数里把所有元素复制成一个大数组。
points.en: Keep only positions (row and column) instead of copying every element into one big array in the constructor.

points.zh: 任意深度的嵌套列表用一个栈保存各层的位置；Python 里用生成器 yield from 最自然。
points.en: For arbitrarily nested lists keep a stack of positions, one per level; in Python a generator with yield from is the natural fit.

pitfalls.zh: 中间或末尾有空行时，hasNext 只看下一行就会返回错误的 true。
pitfalls.en: With empty rows in the middle or at the end, looking only at the next row makes hasNext return a wrong true.

pitfalls.zh: next 里不先调用 hasNext，直接取值会越界。
pitfalls.en: A next that doesn't call hasNext first reads out of bounds.

pitfalls.zh: 迭代过程中修改了原容器：Java 会抛 ConcurrentModificationException，其他语言则是悄悄出错。
pitfalls.en: Modifying the container while iterating throws ConcurrentModificationException in Java and fails silently elsewhere.

pattern.zh: LRU：哈希表 + 双向链表
pattern.en: LRU: hash map plus doubly linked list

points.zh: 哈希表负责 O(1) 找到结点，双向链表负责 O(1) 把结点移到头部、删除尾部。
points.en: The hash map finds a node in O(1); the doubly linked list moves it to the front and drops the tail in O(1).

points.zh: get 也算一次「使用」，要把结点移到最新的一端；put 一个已存在的键要更新值并移动，而不是再插一份。
points.en: A get counts as a use and moves the node to the most recent end; put on an existing key updates and moves it instead of inserting a second copy.

points.zh: 面试要求手写链表时，用头尾两个哨兵结点，插入删除就不用判断空指针。
points.en: When you must hand-roll the list, sentinel head and tail nodes remove every null check.

pitfalls.zh: 淘汰尾结点时只删了链表、没删哈希表里的键（或者反过来）。
pitfalls.en: Evicting the tail from the list but not from the map, or the other way round.

pitfalls.zh: 先插入再淘汰还是先淘汰再插入要统一，并想清楚容量为 0 这种边界。
pitfalls.en: Decide once whether you insert then evict or evict then insert, and think through edge cases such as capacity 0.

pitfalls.zh: 链表结点里不存 key，淘汰时就不知道该删哈希表里的哪一项。
pitfalls.en: Without the key stored in the list node you can't tell which map entry to delete on eviction.

pattern.zh: 字典树：结点存孩子和计数
pattern.en: Trie nodes hold children and counts

points.zh: 每个结点代表一个前缀；插入和查询都是顺着字符往下走，耗时只和单词长度有关。
points.en: Each node is a prefix; insert and lookup walk down one character at a time, so the cost depends only on the word length.

points.zh: 结点上存计数（有多少单词经过、有多少单词在此结束），前缀计数和删除都能 O(L) 完成。
points.en: Counts on the nodes (words passing through, words ending here) make prefix counting and deletion O(L).

points.zh: 序列化二叉树用前序遍历加空结点标记（如 "#"），反序列化时按同样的顺序递归读回来。
points.en: Serialize a binary tree in preorder with a null marker such as "#", and deserialize by reading it back in the same order.

pitfalls.zh: 把 search（完整单词）和 startsWith（前缀）混为一谈，忘了检查结束标记。
pitfalls.en: Mixing up search (a whole word) and startsWith (a prefix) by not checking the end-of-word marker.

pitfalls.zh: 固定 26 叉数组默认只有小写字母；有大写、数字或 Unicode 时，孩子改用哈希表存。
pitfalls.en: A fixed 26-way array assumes lowercase letters; use a hash map of children for uppercase, digits or Unicode.

pitfalls.zh: 序列化时值之间不加分隔符，多位数和负数就没法还原。
pitfalls.en: Serializing without separators makes multi-digit and negative values impossible to parse back.

pattern.zh: 位运算小工具与快速幂
pattern.en: Bit tricks and fast power

points.zh: x & (x-1) 去掉最低位的 1，x & -x 取出最低位的 1；异或满足 a ^ a = 0，可以找出只出现一次的数。
points.en: x & (x-1) clears the lowest set bit and x & -x isolates it; XOR satisfies a ^ a = 0, which finds the element that appears once.

points.zh: 快速幂把指数按二进制拆开：每轮把底数平方，指数这一位是 1 就乘进结果，O(log exp)。
points.en: Fast power splits the exponent into bits: square the base every round and multiply it into the result when the bit is 1, O(log exp).

points.zh: 不超过 20 个元素的集合可以用一个整数当掩码，for (s = mask; s; s = (s-1) & mask) 枚举它的所有非空子集。
points.en: A set of up to 20 items fits in an integer mask; for (s = mask; s; s = (s-1) & mask) enumerates every non-empty submask.

pitfalls.zh: 两个 10^9 量级的数相乘会超出 32 位，取模乘法之前先转成 long / long long。
pitfalls.en: Multiplying two values near 10^9 overflows 32 bits; widen to long / long long before the modular multiply.

pitfalls.zh: Java 的 >> 会保留符号位，处理负数用无符号右移 >>>；Python 整数无限长，负数要先 & 0xFFFFFFFF。
pitfalls.en: Java's >> keeps the sign, so use >>> for negatives; Python ints are unbounded, so mask negatives with & 0xFFFFFFFF first.

pitfalls.zh: C++ 里位运算优先级低于比较：x & 1 == 0 实际是 x & (1 == 0)，一定要加括号（Java 会直接编译报错）。
pitfalls.en: In C++ bitwise operators bind looser than comparisons, so x & 1 == 0 means x & (1 == 0); add parentheses (Java refuses to compile it).
